verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Qualcomm ships a developer ecosystem around this chip: the AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub and GenieX. However, nothing in the evidence documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples. Sample-app repositories with code templates and cloud-hosted device profiling are adjacent features, not an explorable API reference, and the probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
